intro: Meetings and neighbourhood gatherings. Add an event to your own calendar from its page. Sample dates below are not confirmed.

items.title: Lane walk and lighting check
items.venue: Meet at the CRP Nagar Road junction
items.summary: A short walk to note lights and drains that need follow-up.
body: This is a sample event. Confirm any real walk with the committee before you go.
The idea of the walk is simple: note the pole, the drain, or the spot, and pass that list to the secretary.

items.title: Monthly residents' meeting
items.summary: A sample date for the monthly meeting.
body: This date is a placeholder. A real meeting notice should name the place and the agenda.
Households can send a topic through the contact page before the meeting.

items.title: Independence Day gathering
items.summary: A sample of how a past gathering stays on the page.
body: This is a sample past event, kept so the archive has a shape. It is not a report of a gathering that happened.
